fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) outperformed financial transaction industry by 28.4% over the past year (industry average 10.5%), with strong global brand and growth in digital transactions and cross-border remittances as positive drivers.
fields.summary_ko.1: ExxonMobil (XOM) outperformed integrated oil and gas industry by 12.6% over the past six months (industry average 8.3%), and Pfizer (PFE) outperformed large pharma industry by 22.8% over the past year (industry average 33.7%).
